correctness.rationale: The complete subgroup lists consist of P=<pe>, E=<pe,f>, p cyclic p^2 subgroups C_t and p order-p subgroups Q_s in the abelian group; the analogous P,E,C_t,Q_s hold in the modular group. Only P<E, P<C_t and Q_s<E occur, giving a balanced double star. In the abelian group an automorphism e -> a e+b f, f -> pc e + d f induces paired leaf affine maps of slopes d/a and a/d, translations b/a and c/d; all valid parameters give Aut size p^3(p-1)^2. In the modular group a->a^i b^j, b->a^(pk)b induces inverse slopes and two free translations, total Aut size p^3(p-1). The images both have order p^2(p-1) and kernels divide to p(p-1),p. A double star has full Aut of order 2(p!)^2. Algebraic parametrizations work for all odd p; source verifier enumerates p=3,5,7 only.
residual_risks: Finite computations are only corroboration; general statement rests on analytic proof and stated hypotheses.

The contrast is a nontrivial structural invariant across every odd prime, not a numerical coincidence.
